title: MoEQuant EBSS score/sign correctness audit
frozen_at: 2026-11-10, before any new audit test, oracle comparison or audit smoke run was executed

audited_generator.production_entry: generate() (called by EBSSGenerator / ProbabilityOnlyGenerator and by diagnostics/ebss_generation_pilot.py stage_generate / stage_smoke)

canonical_objective.logp_form: J(S||v) = -(L(S) + p_v)/(|S|+1) + sigma(S)/tau, L(S) = sum_i log P(s_i | s_<i) <= 0, p_v = log P(v|S) <= 0; LOWER is better
canonical_objective.sigma: Eq. 3/4: mean over the 24 MoE layers of sqrt(1/(E-1) sum_e (u_e - mean u)^2), u_e = routed top-4 count of the PARENT prefix / |S|; shared expert excluded
canonical_objective.pruning: global top-w SMALLEST J over all (parent, token) pairs of one sentence; ties by (parent, token)
canonical_objective.final: argmin over the w surviving branches of -L(c)/|c| + sigma(c)/tau (balance term omitted for Probability-Only)
canonical_objective.frozen_conventions_audited_not_changed: first token unconditioned (contributes 0 to L, counts in |S| and in sigma); V = ids 0..151645 (log-softmax over this range); no EOS stop; tau = 1.3; w = 4

oracle_requirements: NumPy float64 / Python math.fsum; does not import moe_calib.ebss_generator; recomputes L from per-token log-probabilities, sigma from routing-id tensors, log-softmax from logits, and ranks with np.lexsort / sorted() (no torch.sort)

tolerances.production_vs_oracle_score_given_product: abs <= 1e-9 (same float64 algebra, different summation order)
tolerances.selection_decision: exact identity of the kept (parent, token) set; a mismatch counts as a numerical tie only when the oracle score gap between the disputed candidates is <= 1e-9 (production-logp oracle) / <= 2e-5 (fp64-logit oracle)
tolerances.teacher_forced_logp: reported, not gated bitwise: BF16 batched KV decoding vs batch-1 replay; flag if mean |dlogp| > 0.05 or Pearson r < 0.99 (same thresholds as the pilot smoke gate)

audit_smoke_run: at most 4 sequences x 32 tokens per method, same model/snapshot/BF16/backend, opt-in capture of the full pre-pruning candidate state at every step; not used as calibration data

decision_rule.precedence: SCORE-SIGN-BUG-CONFIRMED -> AUDIT-INCONCLUSIVE -> SCORE-SIGN-CORRECT (paper ambiguity reported as a secondary finding, SCORE-CORRECT-PAPER-AMBIGUOUS only if score correctness cannot be the primary label)
decision_rule.SCORE-SIGN-CORRECT: production matches the independent oracle for the minimisation objective: every fixed counterexample, cross-parent trap, metamorphic invariant, deferred-sigma test and every captured production pruning decision / cumulative update / routing-statistics propagation / final selection agrees (ties within tolerance excepted and reported)
decision_rule.SCORE-SIGN-BUG-CONFIRMED: at least one reproducible production example where the implemented score or ranking differs from the canonical objective because of a sign, log-probability, normalisation or sorting error
decision_rule.SCORE-CORRECT-PAPER-AMBIGUOUS: implementation matches its documented convention but fidelity to the authors' intent cannot be established; secondary when SCORE-SIGN-CORRECT applies
decision_rule.AUDIT-INCONCLUSIVE: the executed path cannot be traced/captured, or the tests cannot distinguish the deliberately wrong variants (wrong-sign NLL, maximisation, per-parent top-w, reversed sigma, wrong-parent sigma) from the correct one

hard_constraints: no new 16x512 / 128x512 data, no GPTQ / reconstruction / PPL, no objective/tau/w changes, generator numerics untouched unless a bug is demonstrated; deliberately wrong variants are evaluated on frozen candidate pools only
